prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+4.4% average after noise correction), winning 3 tests while 3 showed no clear effect.
Home redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.3% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign, as only 1 test has been completed for each.
Predictions were generally too low for winning tests, underestimating their actual performance.
Predictions were consistently too high for tests that showed no clear effect or performed poorly.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: +7.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -8.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +5.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -7.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +4.4% after noise correction, 6 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 70.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Spotlight layout redesign for home intro: Redesign the home intro screen into a spotlight layout showcasing desktop pet interactions before finishing onboarding. (why: Finish step drop-off is highest (64.8% conversion, mean time 5815s) and users reported confusion on how to interact with desktop pets.)
1: [home, wait_info] Notify when ready toggle on waiting screen: Add a system notification toggle and estimated time remaining indicator on the pet generation waiting screen. (why: Waiting step during pet generation takes mean 2336s, leading to abandonment while pet model assets generate.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Two-column layout redesign for pick friend: Redesign the pick friend screen to a two-column layout with side-by-side pet previews and detail cards. (why: Adoption conversion is 70.8%; grid layout was stopped, but a two-column layout provides clearer pet selection comparisons.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Path selection clarity headline and hint: Clarify path selection headlines and add a helpful hint explaining that additional pets can be added later. (why: Path selection has mean 514s completion time and 80.6% conversion, showing hesitation between premade vs photo path.)
4: [adoption, new_flow] Photo submission tips on upload screen: Add a interactive photo quality tip carousel component to the photo upload screen to guide custom pet image uploads. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet photo generation failures or poor output quality during creation.)
5: [sign_in, incentive] Account sync progress badge on sign in screen: Add a visual progress badge on the sign-in screen reassuring users that their pet adoption data is being saved. (why: 8 support emails noted missing pets after re-authenticating; visual feedback reinforces that sign-in preserves pet data.)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop interaction hint on home intro screen: Add a clear hint to the home intro screen detailing drag-and-drop and right-click desktop overlay controls. (why: 3 support tickets complained about confusion controlling, hiding, or talking to the desktop pet after setup.)
7: [sign_in, layout] Compact layout for sign-in screen: Switch the sign-in screen to a compact layout to reduce visual friction and speed up account creation. (why: Sign-in takes median 3s but mean 567s with occasional stalls reported by users; compact layout streamlines input.)
